purpose.en: Stretch the backs of your thighs and your back.

text.zh: 双脚并拢膝盖微弯，从髋部往前折
text.en: Feet together and knees soft, fold forward from your hips

text.zh: 手臂自然垂下，不用硬去够地。
text.en: Let your arms hang freely without forcing them to the floor.
Stay and breathe, then roll up slowly.

commonErrors.en: Locking the knees and forcing the stretch.

cautions.zh: 只拉到舒服的程度，疼就放松
cautions.en: Stretch only to a comfortable point, and ease off if anything hurts.

cautions.zh: 起身时放慢，头晕就停下扶稳
cautions.en: Rise slowly, and stop and hold on to something if you feel dizzy.

changes: 动画每 8 秒一次前折-停 2 s-起身，剂量从 30 秒保持改为 2 组×4 次（rep_hold）
名字「并脚微屈膝无扶体前屈」太长，改「并脚站立体前屈 / Close-Stance Forward Fold」
flags: 原剂量是 30 秒静止保持，但动画每 8 秒做一次「下沉-停住-回来」，按规则改成按次数（rep_hold）；如果想要静止计时，需要动画改成一直停住，请定
改名请确认（原名里的「无扶」用来区分扶椅版本）
